title: Stork Sheeting
instructions: Is by far the newest, most economical, most far-reaching, most satisfactory waterproof fabric known. In hospitals, dispensaries, and for many domestic purposes it is acknowledged by Physicians and Trained Nurses to be far superior to rubber or oiled fabric. It makes sheets that are waterproof, easily cleansed, odorless, easy to handle, and comfortable to the patient. It is soft, pliable, and does not draw or irritate the skin. It causes less work for nurses. It saves laundry bills. It pleases a sick person. For nurses' and surgeons' aprons there never was anything to compare with it.
